sqlMap.select: SELECT A.SUPPLIER, A.EC_USER_EMAIL, A.EC_USER_NAME, A.EC_DATE ||'_'|| REPLACE(B.IRS_NO,'-','') || '_' || C.TEXT1 AS TITLE, B.COM_NAME_LOC AGENT_NAME, B.IRS_NO AGENT_IRS_NO, C.TEXT2 TEMPLATE_ID, C.TEXT3 ROLE FROM SUPLINFO2 A, ICOMCMPY B, ICOMCOD1 C WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SUPPLIER IN ( SELECT TARGET FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ECONT' AND KEY_9 = ' ' AND ROWNUM <= 100 ) AND B.COM_CODE = A.SUPPLIER AND C.TYPE = 'CT01' AND C.CODE = DECODE(A.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y','C2', 'N','C1', '') /*계약서 유형 확인*/ AND A.EC_USER_EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND A.EC_USER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND A.EC_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.SP_TYPE = 'N'

SELECT K.AGENT_NAME COM_NAME_AGENT1, K.FROM_DATE CON_FROMDATE1, K.TO_DATE CON_TODATE1, K.FROM_DATE CONTRACT_DATE1, K.KEP_ADDRESS ADDRESS_KEP1, K.KEP_CEO_NAME CEO_NAME_KEP1, K.AGENT_NAME COM_NAME_AGENT2, K.AGENT_IRS_NO IRS_NO_AGENT1, K.AGENT_ADDRESS ADDRESS_AGENT1, K.AGENT_CEO_NAME CEO_NAME_AGENT1, K.FROM_DATE CONTRACT_DATE2, K.AGENT_NAME COM_NAME_AGENT3, K.AGENT_IRS_NO IRS_NO_AGENT2, K.AGENT_CEO_NAME CEO_NAME_AGENT2, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.AGENT_NAME,NULL) COM_NAME_AGENT4, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.FROM_DATE,NULL) CON_FROMDATE2, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.TO_DATE,NULL) CON_TODATE2, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.FROM_DATE,NULL) CONTRACT_DATE3, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.AGENT_NAME,NULL) COM_NAME_AGENT5, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.AGENT_IRS_NO,NULL) IRS_NO_AGENT3, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.AGENT_ADDRESS,NULL) ADDRESS_AGENT2, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.AGENT_CEO_NAME,NULL) CEO_NAME_AGENT3, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.KEP_ADDRESS,NULL) ADDRESS_KEP2, DECODE(K.E_CONTRACT_FLAG,'Y',K.KEP_CEO_NAME,NULL) CEO_NAME_KEP2 FROM ( SELECT B.COM_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_NAME, B.IRS_NO AS AGENT_IRS_NO, B.CEO_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_CEO_NAME, B.ADDRESS_LOC AS AGENT_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE( A.EC_DATE , 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS FROM_DATE, TO_CHAR( ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(A.EC_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),12), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS TO_DATE, A.E_CONTRACT_FLAG, C.ADDRESS_LOC AS KEP_ADDRESS, C.CEO_NAME_LOC AS KEP_CEO_NAME FROM SUPLINFO2 A, ICOMCMPY B, ICOMCMPY C WHERE A.SUPPLIER = #SUPPLIER# AND B.COM_CODE = A.SUPPLIER AND C.COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' ) K
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = #RESULT_FLAG# , KEY_7 = NVL(SUBSTRB( #RESULT_MSG#, 1, 200 ), ' ') , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ECONT' AND TARGET = #SUPPLIER# AND KEY_9 = ' '
UPDATE SUPLINFO2 SET EC_DOC_ID = #EC_DOC_ID# WHERE SUPPLIER = #SUPPLIER#
sqlMap.select: SELECT A.SUPPLIER, A.EC_DOC_ID FROM SUPLINFO2 A WHERE 1 = 1 AND E_CONTRACT_TYPE IN ('A','B') AND EC_DOC_ID IS NOT NULL
sqlMap.update: UPDATE SUPLINFO2 SET E_CONTRACT_TYPE = #E_CONTRACT_TYPE# WHERE SUPPLIER = #SUPPLIER#
UPDATE ICOMCMPY SET STATUS = 'C' , CONFIRM_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CONFIRM_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE COM_CODE = #SUPPLIER#
UPDATE ICOMLUSR A SET STATUS = 'C' , CONFIRM_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CONFIRM_USER_ID = (SELECT CONFIRM_USER_ID FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE) WHERE COM_CODE = #SUPPLIER#

UPDATE SUPLINFO2 A SET CONFIRM1_USER_ID = (SELECT CONFIRM_USER_ID FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.SUPPLIER) , CONFIRM1_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CONFIRM1_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE SUPPLIER = #SUPPLIER#
UPDATE ACNTSUPL A SET CONFIRM_USER_ID = (SELECT CONFIRM_USER_ID FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.SUPPLIER) , CONFIRM_ADD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') WHERE SUPPLIER = #SUPPLIER#
